protocol.design: Frozen original starter, standard provider connection, one screen repeat: three basic tasks, independent sha256_file and format_json upgrades, one conditional second extension from each fully accepted parent. No operator candidate repairs or promotion. All candidate execution inside disposable VMs. Separate native/JSON compatibility records.
protocol.precision_selection: Compare summed elapsed time of two cache-disabled 128-output-token throughput calls. Q6 <=2x Q4, Q8 <=2x Q4 and <=1.25x Q6; otherwise Q4. Extra Qwen Q4 control. This is adaptive exploratory screening, not precision-specific quality qualification.
protocol.context: 128K Qwen/OxCoder/Ornith, documented 128000 LFM, 64K Swift/Nemotron; Q8 KV throughout; same settings within each family. Publisher reasoning/sampling retained for new reasoning models.
protocol.disk_policy: Maintain 10% SSD reserve plus 3 GiB scratch buffer. Newly downloaded staged precision files are removed after their family completes; metadata, receipts, traces and candidate sources stay. Existing model cache remains intact.
protocol.measurement: Two fixed-length cache-disabled throughput calls plus two bounded tool-format benchmark calls. Tool-format cache warmth uncontrolled. Nonstreaming timing is not TTFT. Provider-reported tokens/timings and incomplete measurements retained.
